Non-standard task list extension tests: task marks holding any character.

-- parser.json --
{"TaskList": true, "TaskMark": true}
-- mark.md --
- [ ] todo
- [x] done
- [X] done
- [u] unknown
- [T] spawn
- [?] huh
- [✓] check
-- mark.html --
<ul>
<li><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> todo</li>
<li><input checked="" disabled="" type="checkbox"> done</li>
<li><input checked="" disabled="" type="checkbox"> done</li>
<li><input data-mark="u" disabled="" type="checkbox"> unknown</li>
<li><input data-mark="T" disabled="" type="checkbox"> spawn</li>
<li><input data-mark="?" disabled="" type="checkbox"> huh</li>
<li><input data-mark="✓" disabled="" type="checkbox"> check</li>
</ul>
-- markesc.md --
- [&] amp
-- markesc.html --
<ul>
<li><input data-mark="&amp;" disabled="" type="checkbox"> amp</li>
</ul>
-- nomark.md --
- [] empty
- [ab] two
- []] bracket
- [u]tight
-- nomark.html --
<ul>
<li>[] empty</li>
<li>[ab] two</li>
<li>[]] bracket</li>
<li>[u]tight</li>
</ul>
